context:
Goal: every pull request gets the review depth its kind of change needs, set by one table, with no gap where two rules disagree.
Problem (rule): rule roles-solo-reviews-logic-diffs-only (in a one-lane run a fresh reviewer reads only changes that touch rule behaviour, a guard, a check or program logic) says other edits merge on checks alone, while the table owes one round for tests-only changes, so only you can say which governs.
Based on (read): the plan plan on branch lane/pr-template-risk-tiers (docs/plans/pr-template-risk-tiers.md, read from main commit 69ab998832, 21:38 CST Nov 17): the solo rule and the table disagree for tests-only changes.
Departs from: main — the solo rule lets tests-only changes merge on checks alone and the table owes one round — one reading is picked (a or b).
Waiting on: nothing is stopped; step pr-template-risk-tiers waits on your pick, then a test-author writes the template-check cases and a builder lands them.

options.gain: A weakened test is caught by a reader, not only by green checks.
options.how: The solo rule is reworded to except tests-only changes.
options.label: Owe one round on tests-only changes, as the table says (recommended)
options.lose: One more review on small test edits in one-lane runs.

options.gain: No review cost on test edits.
options.how: The table row reads: rounds owed 0 in a one-lane run.
options.label: Tests-only changes merge on passing checks alone, as the solo rule says
options.lose: A test that was loosened to pass can merge unread; your rule says a failing test is a claim to re-point or fix.

ref: owner chat 19:45 CST Nov 17 (relayed by the consultant): land the verification article's findings; PR template lines and risk tiers by change
reply: Closed. You picked b: in a one-lane run, a pull request that changes only tests merges on passing checks alone; the tier table row reads rounds owed 0. Filed on step pr-template-risk-tiers.
short: Tier table: does a tests-only change in a one-lane run owe a review round?

shown.label: Owe one round on tests-only changes, as the table says (recommended)
Tests-only changes merge on passing checks alone, as the solo rule says

title: In a run with one lane, does a pull request that changes only tests get one review round, or merge on passing checks alone?
why: a keeps a human-style read on tests, which your rule treats as claims; b saves a round but lets a loosened test through unread. Recommended by triage, not owner-typed.
